Sure, my name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Do you also need my date of birth, or is that enough?
Yes, I’m using the 555-123-2002 number on my phone—the one I mentioned earlier. That’s the line with the “No Service” problem.
Oh, I didn’t realize there was an overdue bill. Yes, please go ahead and send me the payment request so I can take care of it. I really need my phone working again.

I followed your instructions and restarted my phone, but now I see a little airplane icon at the top of the screen. It still says “No Service.” Is that normal? What should I do next?
Oh, I didn’t realize that was on! Yes, please, I’d really appreciate your help turning off Airplane Mode. I’m not sure how to do it.
If you could do it for me, that would be wonderful—I get a bit confused with all the icons and menus. Please go ahead and turn off Airplane Mode for me.
Okay, Airplane Mode is now turned off, but I still see “No Signal” at the top of my screen. Is there something else I should try? I’m starting to get a little worried—will my phone ever work again?

I checked, and my phone still shows “No Signal” at the top. Also, it looks like my SIM card is locked with a PIN code. I’m not sure what that means—could that be why I can’t get service? What should I do next?
